# Vipan Kumar

> Engineering architect and leader based in Ontario (Greater Toronto Area), Canada. 15 years (2011 to present) building multi-tenant SaaS and event-driven systems on AWS, Azure and GCP, including a regulated BFSI platform. Currently Principal Software Architect (Consultant). Still hands-on in production code.

Platforms and systems delivered for Lenskart, Walmart India KDP, Domino's India, Maruti Suzuki and Samsung R&D Institute.

## Key results
- OnGrid: 10x Kafka throughput across 13 topics with no added infrastructure, 99.95% uptime, AWS costs down 22%, led SOC 2 Type 1.
- Dresma: GPU servers cut from 12 to 5 for the same output; platform grew to US$2M ARR.
- Lenskart: orders a day scaled from 300-500 to 8,000+ with the same small team.
- SignCatch and Walmart KDP: 500 kirana stores onboarded in beta; multi-tenant POS across 700+ retail locations.
- Gigforce: first engineer; team grown from 1 to about 15; US$3M pre-Series A.
